description: This file defines the LogicalNode class, which models logical expression nodes like AND, OR, and NOT within a predicate AST. It includes constructors, getters, and an enum for node types.

classes.name: LogicalNode
classes.description: Represents a logical node in an expression tree, such as AND, OR, or NOT, with associated sub-nodes.

methods.name: LogicalNode(String name)
methods.description: Constructs a LogicalNode with the specified name.

methods.name: LogicalNode(Type type)
methods.description: Constructs a LogicalNode with the specified type.

methods.name: LogicalNode(Type type, Node... subNodes)
methods.description: Constructs a LogicalNode with the specified type and child nodes.

methods.name: LogicalNode(Type type, Collection<Node> subNodes)
methods.description: Constructs a LogicalNode with the specified type and collection of child nodes.

methods.name: getName()
methods.description: Returns the name of the logical node (e.g., 'and', 'or', 'not').

methods.name: getType()
methods.description: Returns the type (enum) of the logical node.

methods.name: accept(PredicateVisitor predicateVisitor)
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to process this node.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the logical node.

methods.name: hashCode()
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the node.

methods.name: byName(String name)
methods.description: Returns the enum Type corresponding to the given name.
